_comment: Example Claude Code settings for claude-questions-in-browser.
Merge these blocks into ~/.claude/settings.json (all projects) or a project's
.claude/settings.json (that project only). If you already have `env`, `hooks`, or a
`PreToolUse` array, add to them rather than replacing them.
Adjust the clone path in `command`, and drop the `env` block entirely to use your
default browser and leave focus alone.
CLAUDE_ASK_KEEP_FOCUS keeps the question from stealing focus mid-sentence. Swap it for
CLAUDE_ASK_ACTIVATE ("Google Chrome") if you would rather be pulled to the page instead;
setting both is pointless, as KEEP_FOCUS wins.
With focus left alone, the sound is what tells you a question arrived. CLAUDE_ASK_WAIT_MS
and the hook `timeout` must move together: the hook surrenders at WAIT_MS so Claude Code
never kills it at `timeout`, which would leave you with no fallback.
